sequence.name: Trail Pack onboarding
sequence.consent_evidence: Signup form consent checkbox plus confirmation click, stored with timestamp and IP in the CRM

sender.postal_address: 12 Quarry Lane, Bristol BS1 4AA, United Kingdom

exit_conditions: opened a support ticket in the last 3 days

emails.job: Confirm the account and show where to start
emails.subject: Welcome to Trail Pack, your account is ready
emails.preheader: Three things worth doing in your first five minutes

emails.job: Get the reader to build their first gear list
emails.subject: Build your first gear list in two minutes
emails.preheader: Start from a template instead of a blank page

emails.job: Show how another hiker used a list to prepare a trip
emails.subject: How Priya packed for a 4-day coastal walk
emails.preheader: Her list, her mistakes, and what she would change

emails.job: Offer free delivery on a first order
emails.subject: Free delivery on your first order, through Friday

emails.job: Ask what is stopping the first order and close the sequence
emails.subject: Is something missing from Trail Pack?
emails.preheader: Reply to this email, a person reads every answer
